decisions.rationale: Test pure set-based execution to minimize gets, full lookup caching to evaluate memory trade-offs, and balanced bulk-collect options across the independent loops.
Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE for minimal consistent gets, plus mixed SET_BASED and cache configurations to uncover non-dominated trade-offs between memory and I/O.

Eval 9 showed SET_BASED + BULK_500/LOOKUP_CACHE achieved very low f1 with low memory (3264KB). Testing combinations with one or two BULK_500+CACHE sites against SET_BASED explores the steep Pareto trade-off between 9099 and 39301 f1.
Test combinations of SET_BASED with BULK_50/BULK_500 and selective caching to balance low logical reads against memory footprint.
Evaluating selective caching combinations with SET_BASED and BULK_50/500 to find optimal intermediate trade-offs between f1 logical reads and f2 PGA footprint.
Evaluating combinations where s1 is SET_BASED and s3/s5 use mixed BULK_50/500 with LOOKUP_CACHE, aiming to improve on run 13 and run 9 by reducing memory while maintaining low logical I/O.
Evaluating configurations that pair BULK_50 on s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE on s1 or s5 and SET_BASED to test whether memory remains low (~3.2-3.5MB) while getting close to f1 ~39k or lower.
Explores combinations with SET_BASED at s3, testing whether caching R1 or R3 alone or both with minimal bulk sizes yields pareto-optimal trade-offs between 3200KB and 28000KB.

Combining SET_BASED for s1/s5 with BULK_50/500 on s3 and LOOKUP_CACHE on s4 yielded strong Pareto points around ~39k gets and ~3.2-3.6MB PGA. Testing BULK_500 on all loops with selective caching explores missing combinations.

Explore SET_BASED combined with BULK and selective cache combinations, particularly looking at s1=SET_BASED, s3=BULK_500, s5=BULK_500 with s6=LOOKUP_SQL vs cache variations, to sharpen the Pareto frontier between 9042 and 39108 gets.
Evaluating combinations where SET_BASED is paired with BULK_500 and LOOKUP_CACHE for s5/s6 or across s1, targeting non-dominated trade-offs between f1 ~9k-39k and lower memory.
Explores combining SET_BASED across two sites with low-overhead BULK_50/BULK_500 caching or pure SQL variants to bridge the frontier between f1=39k and f1=9k, and probes ROW cache combinations.
Test low-memory variants using ROW or BULK_50 on s1 paired with SET_BASED and LOOKUP_CACHE to uncover low PGA points balancing gets.
Test low-memory ROW/BULK combinations paired with SET_BASED to discover non-dominated trade-offs between 3000KB and 3500KB PGA.
Evaluating ROW with cache on s2/s4 paired with SET_BASED on s5 or BULK configurations to refine the low-PGA Pareto boundary between 2816KB and 3136KB.
Test low-memory variants around s1=SET_BASED, s3=BULK, s5=SET_BASED with minimal PGA, exploring BULK_50/BULK_500 trade-offs.
Combining SET_BASED with two low-overhead cache lookups or finding low PGA configurations between 39k and 58k consistent gets.
Investigate hybrid boundaries: testing minimal f1 configurations with BULK_50/BULK_500 caching variations and testing low-memory SET_BASED/ROW blends to discover Pareto front improvements.
Testing SET_BASED at s1/s5 alongside BULK_50/500 and LOOKUP_CACHE options to find non-dominated trade-offs between f1 ~9k-39k and low PGA.
Test BULK_50/BULK_500 combinations with LOOKUP_CACHE and SET_BASED to refine the Pareto front between f1 ~39k and 9k, and evaluate ROW/BULK_50 blends with low memory.

Test pure set-based execution to minimize consistent gets, plus intermediate bulk and cache combinations to map the Pareto frontier between memory footprint and logical I/O across the three symmetric loops.

BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE may reduce buffer gets further. We also test mixed configurations caching selective lookups or combining SET_BASED loops with LOOKUP_CACHE loops to bridge the PGA-gets trade-off.
Test caching only a single lookup with BULK/SET_BASED loops to discover balanced trade-offs between low PGA overhead and reduced logical I/O.
Evaluating configurations that combine SET_BASED loops with single or double LOOKUP_CACHE and BULK collection to map the frontier between low memory (3MB) and minimum consistent gets.

Caching R3 alone or combinations with SET_BASED/BULK_500 test intermediate memory and logical reads. Caching R3 consumes high memory (~25MB), while R1/R2 consume far less, so pairing SET_BASED with BULK_5000 explores lower f1.

Notice s6=LOOKUP_CACHE consumes ~25MB memory. With s5=SET_BASED, memory stays low (<4MB). Testing s1=BULK_50/500, s3=BULK_50/500, s5=SET_BASED allows caching R1 and R2 while avoiding R3's huge cache footprint.
Test ROW combined with BULK_50/BULK_500 caching and SET_BASED to discover lower PGA points around the 39k-59k f1 range.
Evaluating combinations mixing SET_BASED with BULK and LOOKUP_SQL/CACHE to balance low PGA (close to original 2496KB) with reduced buffer gets.
Test single-cache configurations with SET_BASED combinations or pure low-memory options to refine trade-offs between f1=39k-87k and f2=2.4MB-3.2MB.
Testing s5=BULK variants with s1/s3 SET_BASED or cached to improve low-f1, low-memory regions.
Explores minimal PGA configurations using ROW with LOOKUP_SQL combined with cached lookups in s3/s5 to bridge f1 and memory trade-offs near the lower f2 boundary.
Test single and double LOOKUP_CACHE configurations with SET_BASED and ROW/BULK combinations to locate lower PGA regions without the 28MB penalty incurred when caching s6 (T3).
Evaluating combinations with SET_BASED on s1 and s5 alongside caching or smaller bulk operations to find Pareto-optimal trade-offs between f1 (39k) and f2 (2.8k-3.2k).
Target low PGA and low logical reads by combining SET_BASED at s1/s5 with row-level cache at s3, or testing s1=SET_BASED, s3=BULK_50/500 with s5/s6 variations to fill gaps in the Pareto front.
Target Pareto gaps between f1=29k and f1=9k: test combinations where s1/s5 are SET_BASED or cached to minimize logical reads, while keeping BULK or CACHE on remaining loops to control f2.
Test BULK_50 combinations with LOOKUP_CACHE at s3/s5 and s1=SET_BASED, targeting low memory variants between 28MB and 3MB to refine Pareto trade-offs.
Test BULK_50 on s1 combined with SET_BASED/CACHE configurations to find non-dominated points between f1=39k and f1=87k at low memory footprints (~3000KB).
Target the low f1/intermediate f2 trade-off by combining SET_BASED with two LOOKUP_CACHE sites to avoid R3 caching bloat, and explore low-memory ROW/BULK-50 combinations across loops.
Test combinations of BULK/SET_BASED loops with single or double cache configurations to find low memory points improving on Pareto front around 3136-3264 KB.
Combine BULK_50/BULK_500 with LOOKUP_CACHE at s1 and s3 while keeping s5=SET_BASED, aiming to match or improve f1 (~39k) at very low PGA (~3.5MB).
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops to establish the optimal f1 baseline, alongside moderate and large BULK variations with caching to explore the memory vs logical I/O trade-off curve.

Test mixing SET_BASED (low memory, moderate gets) and BULK_500 with LOOKUP_CACHE to explore intermediate memory/buffer get trade-offs, alongside testing single-cache setups with lower memory footprints.
Test combinations of SET_BASED with selective LOOKUP_CACHE to explore low-memory, low-I/O frontiers between 2.8MB and 28MB PGA.
Evaluating s3=BULK_500 with s1/s5=SET_BASED, which should sharply cut f1 below run 14 while keeping PGA low (around 3.5MB, avoiding R3's huge cache). Also probing selective caching combinations.
Notice s4 cache has low PGA (~3.2MB) with SET_BASED s1 and s5. Combining s1, s3, s5 in various partial set/bulk/cache combinations will test if s6 cache or specific bulk pairings dominate.

Caches on s2 and s4 consume little PGA (~3.5MB), whereas s6 cache explodes memory (~28MB). Combining SET_BASED on s5 with variations on s1/s3 should explore the Pareto knee around 38k-39k f1 and 3MB PGA.
Evaluating BULK_5000 on s3 with s1/s2 cache configurations, and exploring whether s1=BULK_5000 s3=BULK_500 s5=SET_BASED pushes f1 lower without incurring excessive memory like s6 cache.

Notice s5 LOOKUP_CACHE causes massive PGA (~28MB), while s2 and s4 LOOKUP_CACHE keep PGA low (~3MB). Combining SET_BASED at s1 with BULK_5000/BULK_500 on s3 and s5=SET_BASED explores the low-gets, low-memory frontier.
S5=SET_BASED keeps PGA low (<4MB). Exploring combinations with caching on S2/S4 while varying S1/S3 cursor limits will refine Pareto trade-offs near 39k-58k gets and 2.8MB-3.5MB PGA.
Test single/dual SET_BASED with LOOKUP_CACHE combinations to find memory-efficient trade-offs between f1=39k (PGA~3.2MB) and f1=9k (PGA~29MB).
Test combinations pairing SET_BASED at s5 with cached loops at s1 and s3 to bridge low f1 and low memory gaps.
Evaluating BULK on s5 with LOOKUP_CACHE while using SET_BASED/BULK elsewhere to explore f1-f2 trade-offs between 9k and 29k gets.

Evaluating intermediate PGA regimes where s1 and s3 use cache lookups while keeping s5 lightweight, or targeting s1=BULK_500 with s3=SET_BASED and s5=ROW to test unexplored boundaries between 9k-29k gets and low PGA.
Evaluating BULK_5000 at s3 to check if it matches or beats BULK_5000 at s1, and testing single CACHE configurations with SET_BASED to discover lower f2 frontiers.
Test s5=BULK variants with LOOKUP_SQL against s1/s3 cache/set-based combinations to balance low PGA (avoiding s6 cache) with reduced gets across all three loops.
Test single-cache combinations with SET_BASED and low-overhead BULK or ROW settings to discover minimal PGA trade-offs under 2800KB.
Test low-memory set-based and cached lookup balances to challenge the low-f1 boundary and bridge gaps between f2=2816KB and 3264KB.
Test single-cache configurations and unexplored bulk combinations on the non-dominated edge to minimize f1 under tight memory constraints.

Evaluate SET_BASED across all loops combined with cache/SQL variations, particularly testing s1=SET_BASED, s3=BULK_50, s5=SET_BASED with LOOKUP_SQL or hybrid caching to probe near-Pareto trade-offs with low memory footprints.
Test minimal memory trade-offs using SET_BASED across pairs with cached lookups in s2/s4/s6 to bridge Pareto frontier gaps.

Test pure SET_BASED rewrite across all three loops to evaluate the theoretical lower bound for consistent gets, alongside balanced bulk and cached lookups to explore intermediate memory-I/O trade-offs.
Test BULK_5000 with LOOKUP_CACHE to see if f1 improves further, plus mixed configurations testing individual caches against SET_BASED loops to balance memory consumption and logical I/O.

Config 9 showed very low memory despite two LOOKUP_CACHE sites, likely because R1/R2 are small while R3 is huge. We test combinations caching only R1 and R2 with SET_BASED or BULK to map the trade-off.

Notice R3 cache imposes ~28MB PGA overhead, whereas R1/R2 caches cost very little PGA. Test s1/s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE and s5 SET_BASED using minimal BULK sizes or mixed ROW/BULK to explore low-memory, low-get trade-offs.

Notice R3 table caching (s5 != SET_BASED) explodes PGA to ~28MB, whereas s5=SET_BASED keeps PGA tiny (~3MB). Combining s1=SET_BASED, s3=BULK_500, and s5=SET_BASED yielded f1=39301 with small memory; try other combinations.
Test combinations of SET_BASED on s1 and s3 with BULK or LOOKUP_CACHE on s5 to find intermediate trade-offs between f1 and f2.
Notice R3 table caching incurs ~25MB memory, whereas R1/R2 do not. Test SET_BASED on s1 and s3 with BULK on s5 to isolate whether s5 alone causes memory spikes.
Test combinations pairing SET_BASED with LOOKUP_SQL and BULK_50/500 to find intermediate Pareto points around f2=2800KB-3200KB.
Test single-lookup cache with dual SET_BASED variants and explore whether BULK_50/ROW on s1/s3 with s5=SET_BASED achieves low PGA with competitive consistent gets.
Test combinations pairing SET_BASED with LOOKUP_SQL or selective LOOKUP_CACHE across s1, s3, and s5 to discover tighter f1-f2 trade-offs without incurring full lookup cache overhead.

Notice s6=LOOKUP_CACHE introduces massive ~28MB PGA overhead, whereas s2 and s4 LOOKUP_CACHE have negligible PGA footprints (~3MB). Testing SET_BASED at s3 with s2=LOOKUP_CACHE and minimal s5 will explore new low-PGA Pareto points.
S5=LOOKUP_CACHE consumes ~25MB PGA, whereas S2/S4 caches are lean (~300-400KB). Pairing SET_BASED at S1/S3/S5 with minimal memory alternatives explores missing Pareto points.
Test single-cache combinations with minimal bulk PGA footprint (ROW or BULK_50) across s1 and s3 while keeping SET_BASED on remaining loops to achieve balanced f1 and sub-3000KB f2.
Test single-cache combinations with minimal bulk sizes or rows to push memory down around 2.5-3.0MB while improving f1 compared to pure SQL lookups.
Test single-cache combinations with SET_BASED and BULK_50/500 to find tight Pareto trade-offs around 3000KB memory and 39k-87k gets.
Test combinations of SET_BASED on s1 and s3 with BULK or LOOKUP_CACHE on s5 to bridge the gap between 9k-39k gets and low memory.
Test minimal memory footprint combinations with ROW/SET_BASED, and explore BULK_50/BULK_500 with LOOKUP_CACHE for s3 while keeping s1 and s5 SET_BASED.
Test two SET_BASED stages combined with LOOKUP_CACHE on remaining stages or low-memory bulkings to improve the trade-off frontier between 39k and 9k f1.
Evaluating ROW on s1/s3 paired with low memory, or minimal combinations around s1=SET_BASED, s3=ROW/BULK, and s5=SET_BASED to discover new Pareto trade-offs near 2.5-3.0 MB PGA.
Evaluating ROW with cache on s4 or combining SET_BASED with cache lookups balances gets and PGA near Pareto frontiers (e.g. around 2.8MB-3.1MB), targeting uncovered high-leverage points.
Explore full SET_BASED to establish the minimum consistent gets baseline, alongside moderate bulk batches (BULK_500) and caching combinations to span memory-IO trade-offs across the three loops.
Caching all tables yields extreme f1 drops at high PGA; test caching selectively (one or two tables) with SET_BASED or BULK_500 to find intermediate Pareto points between 2.8MB and 29MB PGA.

Test selective caching and SET_BASED combinations to find intermediate memory trade-offs. Checking if single-table cache preloading with SET_BASED or BULK provides low logical I/O without incurring the full ~29MB memory cost.

Config 15 showed caching s2 and s4 while using SET_BASED for s5 yields very low f1 with modest f2 (3648KB). Testing SET_BASED across s1/s3 paired with selective caching explores sweet spots between f1 and f2.

Notice s3=BULK+LOOKUP_CACHE drastically reduces f1 with low PGA when s1,s5 are SET_BASED (#17). Test BULK_5000 on s3, or BULK_50/500 with ROW or SET_BASED combinations to locate the exact trade-off boundary.

Notice s5 LOOKUP_CACHE costs ~25MB PGA alone (G06_THREE_REFS_R3 is large). Testing configurations with s2 and/or s4 cached alongside SET_BASED or BULK to explore intermediate memory regimes without the massive s6 cache penalty.
Evaluating s1/s5 SET_BASED combinations with varying bulk limits for s3 and caching at s4 to explore the trade-off near f1 ~39k-59k and low memory.

Notice that s6=LOOKUP_CACHE accounts for ~25MB PGA spikes. Combining s1=SET_BASED, s3=BULK_500/50, and s5=ROW with LOOKUP_SQL or testing SET_BASED at s3 with s5=BULK_LOOKUP explores low-memory boundaries.
Evaluating configurations where R2 is cached with SET_BASED at s1/s5 and different bulk or minimal row variants, or testing combinations with low f2 and low f1.
Evaluating combinations where s6 uses LOOKUP_CACHE alongside SET_BASED at s1/s3 to probe the unvisited high-efficiency, lower-PGA frontiers between 39k and 87k gets.
Test combinations of SET_BASED at s1 and s3 with BULK variations at s5 to bridge the gap between 29084 f1 and 9042 f1, optimizing memory while keeping logical reads low.
Evaluate SET_BASED at s1 and s5 while varying s3 with LOOKUP_SQL or hybrid combinations, aiming for optimal intermediate memory/gets trade-offs.
Test single-cache configurations and SET_BASED variants with low bulk limits to minimize memory while reducing gets between 39k and 87k.
Test combinations pairing SET_BASED at s1 and s5 with varied BULK/LOOKUP_CACHE at s3 to find memory-efficient intermediates, plus explore multi-cache ROW options to push the low-PGA boundary.
Explores combinations with low PGA overhead around ROW/BULK_50 and SET_BASED to fill gaps between 3136KB and 3264KB, targeting f1 reductions at minimal memory cost.
Testing s1=SET_BASED, s3=BULK_500, s5=BULK_50/500 with LOOKUP_CACHE configurations to find non-dominated points between f1=9k-29k and minimal memory footprint.
Test low-memory permutations using ROW or BULK_50 with LOOKUP_SQL/CACHE paired with SET_BASED to fill gaps between f1=39k-87k and minimal f2 (2496KB-2816KB).
Test low-PGA configurations combining ROW or SET_BASED with specific cache combinations to identify trade-offs along the lower PGA frontier.
Target the low f2 region between 2496KB and 2816KB by pairing SET_BASED with minimal memory ROW/BULK_50 configurations to uncover tighter Pareto tradeoffs.
Test lower PGA points around the Pareto boundary by combining ROW/BULK with selective cache/SET_BASED implementations.

Test extreme points and standard high-throughput bulk options to map the initial Pareto frontier: all SET_BASED minimizes logical I/O, BULK options test balanced memory trade-offs, and LOOKUP_CACHE tests lookup isolation.

SET_BASED dramatically reduces f1 with very low PGA overhead, while LOOKUP_CACHE achieves minimal f1 at high memory cost. Testing BULK_5000 with cache, and mixing SET_BASED with caching/bulk to explore trade-off boundaries.
Test selective caching and bulk sizes alongside SET_BASED: evaluate caching only one or two lookups to explore intermediate PGA tiers between 3MB and 28MB while sharply dropping consistent gets.

Config 16 revealed caching only R2 yields huge I/O reductions with minimal memory overhead (~3MB). Exploring other single/double cache combinations with SET_BASED or varying bulk sizes to map the low-memory Pareto frontier.
Evaluating BULK_5000 at s3 with SET_BASED at s1/s5 and LOOKUP_CACHE at s4 tests whether higher bulk limits further reduce gets around the low-PGA sweet spot discovered in config 17.
Combining SET_BASED at s1 and s3 with BULK/CACHE at s5 tests low PGA vs f1 reductions, while caching across s1 and s3 with minimal bulk sizes explores tighter memory margins.

Notice s6=LOOKUP_CACHE consumes ~28MB PGA alone (R3 is large). s4=LOOKUP_CACHE (R2) is tiny (~3MB PGA) and slashes f1 dramatically. Test configurations with s4=LOOKUP_CACHE and s2=LOOKUP_SQL/SET_BASED to discover minimal f1 under tight memory.
Combine BULK_5000 at s3 with SET_BASED and cache variants to test if s3 dominates I/O reductions at modest memory, while exploring s5 caching without large bulk overheads.
Evaluating intermediate PGA-caching configurations: combining s1 SET_BASED with s3 cache and s5 bulk to bridge the gap between f1 ~39k and f1 ~9k without extreme memory blowup.
Test low PGA combinations pairing s3 LOOKUP_CACHE with s1/s5 SET_BASED or ROW to identify configurations Pareto-optimal between f1=39k-87k and f2=2800-3200KB.
Caching s4 with SET_BASED at s1/s5 gives low gets at ~3MB PGA. Exploring SET_BASED at s3 with cache/bulk at s5 or testing lower PGA variations around s1/s3.
Test combinations of s1/s3 caching with s5=BULK/SET_BASED, exploring intermediate memory (3000-3500KB) and low f1 Pareto regions.
Test caching on s4 and s6 with low-memory SET_BASED/BULK combinations to fill gaps between 9K-39K f1.
Evaluating combinations with SET_BASED at s1 and s3 or s5, exploring whether caching s6 or s4 while s3 or s5 is BULK minimizes gets without ballooning PGA excessively.
Test configurations where s5 is absorbed by SET_BASED while earlier sites balance logical reads and low PGA caching, plus evaluate pure baseline variants to refine Pareto tradeoffs.
Combine BULK_500/BULK_50 on s1 and s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE and SET_BASED on s5 to find minimal f1 at low PGA.
Test BULK_500/CACHE across s1 and s3 combined with ROW or BULK on s5 to find lower memory Pareto frontiers.
Testing s5=SET_BASED combined with minimal s1/s3 cache memory footprints to explore trade-offs between low PGA (sub-3MB) and consistent gets under 60k.
Test single and dual LOOKUP_CACHE configurations with BULK_500/ROW and SET_BASED to fill gaps between f1 ~9k-39k and lower memory profiles.
Test combinations of SET_BASED on s1 and s5 while caching s3 with minimal BULK overhead to lower memory below current Pareto points.
Test pure SET_BASED across all loops for minimal I/O and PGA overhead, then explore selective caching and moderate bulk sizing to map early Pareto trade-offs.
Test BULK_5000 with cache to push f1 lower, and mix SET_BASED with BULK+LOOKUP_CACHE to explore intermediate memory-I/O trade-offs across independent stages.
Evaluation 11 showed caching a single lookup (s4) uses only 3200KB PGA while slashing gets. We test BULK_50/BULK_500 with s4 cached alongside SET_BASED to discover optimal low-memory, low-get points.
Caching s4 with s3 BULK yields huge f1 gains at low PGA (<3.3MB). Caching s2+s4 while keeping s5 SET_BASED or testing s3 BULK with s1,s5 SET_BASED should explore sharp Pareto trade-offs.
Notice R3 cache costs ~25MB PGA alone, while R1/R2 cache costs very little memory. Test caching s2 and s4 while using SET_BASED for s1/s3 or tuning bulk sizes to minimize f1 under low memory.
Caching s2 and s4 while using SET_BASED for s5 yielded Pareto points (39k f1, ~3.6MB PGA). Testing SET_BASED at s1 or s3 combined with mixed caches explores low PGA regions with minimal gets.
Notice R3 cache inflates memory to ~28MB, whereas R1 and R2 cache consume very little memory (~3.5MB). BULK_5000 with R1/R2 cache could reduce f1 below 39108 while maintaining low PGA.
Test single-cache combinations with SET_BASED to fill gaps between low memory and low logical I/O.
S6 LOOKUP_CACHE bloats PGA to ~28MB, whereas caching S2 and S4 stays under 4MB. Exploring ROW/BULK combinations for S1 and S3 with SET_BASED at S5 targets optimal f1-f2 trade-offs.
Testing s5=BULK variants with s1=SET_BASED and s3=BULK_500/CACHE to bridge memory gaps, plus exploring BULK_500 in s1 with s3=BULK_50/CACHE to tighten the 39k f1 cluster memory footprint.
Test configurations where s5 is absorbed by SET_BASED with BULK+LOOKUP_CACHE on s1/s3, and check if SET_BASED on s1 and s3 with BULK on s5 achieves low PGA and competitive f1.

Evaluating intermediate PGA regimes: caching R1 and R2 while setting S5 to SET_BASED yielded strong trade-offs (~39k gets, ~3.2-3.6MB PGA). Testing finer granularities for S1/S3 to improve the Pareto frontier.
Test combinations of SET_BASED at s1 and s5 while varying s3 with LOOKUP_CACHE, and explore BULK_500 on s1 paired with SET_BASED at s3 to find Pareto improvements.
Evaluating configurations pairing ROW caching with BULK/SET_BASED to discover sharper trade-offs between low PGA (f2 ~3000KB) and logical gets (f1 ~39k-58k), particularly testing ROW caching on s1.
Test combinations of SET_BASED at s1 and s5 or BULK/CACHE allocations to uncover optimal trade-offs around 30k-40k f1 and low memory.
Test BULK_500 in s1 and s3 with SET_BASED in s5, or vice-versa, with asymmetric cache placements, particularly probing low memory trade-offs around 3.2MB–3.5MB PGA.
Test single-cache configurations with SET_BASED across remaining sites to minimize memory overhead while reducing logical reads below baseline SET_BASED.
Test combinations of SET_BASED at s1 and s3/s5 to exploit minimal PGA while maintaining low logical I/O, exploring unvisited symmetric and low-memory bulk configurations.
Combine minimal PGA (SET_BASED in s1 and s5) with low f1 using LOOKUP_CACHE only on s4 to find intermediate Pareto points around 2.8MB-3.2MB PGA.
Evaluating combinations with two SET_BASED sites or ROW+CACHE to discover low-memory Pareto points below 2816KB/2496KB or optimize gets around 3000KB PGA.
Evaluate all-SET_BASED for minimum consistent gets, moderate bulk collects for memory-gets balance, and selective caching to explore Pareto extremes across the three parallel loops.
Test mixing SET_BASED across loops and combining SET_BASED with LOOKUP_CACHE to explore intermediate logical I/O vs memory trade-offs between all-SET_BASED (88k gets) and all-CACHE (9k gets, 29MB).
Test caching individual lookups combined with SET_BASED loops. Evaluation 10 showed caching s2 alone consumes only ~3.5MB PGA, offering huge f1 drops at low memory cost.
Eval 13 showed SET_BASED + BULK_500 + SET_BASED with s4 cache achieves low f1 with modest memory. Testing BULK_50 on s3 or caching selective tables tests the trade-off near 39k f1 and ~3MB memory.
Evaluating BULK_50/BULK_500 with LOOKUP_CACHE at s1 and s3 while SET_BASED at others to map low-memory vs low-gets tradeoffs.
Explores combinations with low memory (3200KB-3500KB range) and caching to bridge the gap between f1=39k and f1=9k, and refines BULK_50/ROW tradeoffs around the current Pareto frontier.
Test combinations of SET_BASED on s1 and s5 while varying lookup caching on s3 to discover sharper trade-offs between low PGA (near 3MB) and reduced buffer gets around 39k-58k.
Test low-memory Pareto frontier combinations between ROW/SET_BASED and single-lookup caching (s3=BULK+CACHE vs s5=SET_BASED).
Test single-cache configurations targeting s4 to check if low PGA can be preserved while achieving lower f1 than ROW, or explore SET_BASED combinations with low bulk sizes.
Test caching on R2 while keeping s1 and s5 minimal memory or set-based; explore ROW/ROW with partial caching to see if f1 improves at lower PGA than full cache.
Test combinations of SET_BASED on s1 and s5 while varying s3 caching and bulk size to balance f1 and low memory.
Test single and dual LOOKUP_CACHE configurations with SET_BASED and small bulk sizes to discover intermediate trade-offs between low I/O and low memory.
Test minimal memory trade-offs around low-PGA baselines, investigating whether ROW or low-limit BULK with selective caches or SET_BASED combinations can bridge gaps in the Pareto front.
Test combinations of ROW/low BULK with SET_BASED and targeted LOOKUP_CACHE to bridge Pareto gaps between 2800KB and 3300KB PGA.
Evaluating combinations where SET_BASED is paired with selective LOOKUP_CACHE on s4/s6 or low-memory bulk configurations to discover points filling the trade-off gap between 2496KB and 3136KB PGA.
Test combinations of SET_BASED at s1 and s5 paired with low-overhead caching at s3/s4 to seek Pareto improvements around 39k f1 with lower PGA than BULK variants.
Combining SET_BASED for s1/s3 with s5=BULK/LOOKUP_CACHE or s5=SET_BASED explores missing trade-offs between low logical gets and minimal memory footprint.
Test low-memory alternatives around SET_BASED/ROW combinations and probe whether s5=SET_BASED combined with minimal cache usage reduces f1 while preserving minimal f2.
Test minimal memory configurations using ROW/BULK_50 with cache combinations to push the frontier below 2816KB while maintaining competitive consistent gets.
Test minimal memory trade-offs using SET_BASED alongside minimal bulk buffers or caching configurations, aiming to beat the Pareto points around 2496KB–2816KB.
Evaluate all-SET_BASED for minimal gets, pure LOOKUP_CACHE for low memory overhead, and balanced BULK collect configurations with caches to map both extremes of the Pareto front.
Test BULK_* with LOOKUP_SQL to bridge the memory gap between pure SET_BASED (2.8MB) and LOOKUP_CACHE (29MB), potentially achieving low f1 with minimal PGA impact.

Caching s4 with SET_BASED at s1, s5 gave high f1 reduction for modest PGA. Testing caching individual other lookups (s2 or s6) and combinations of two cached lookups to explore intermediate Pareto trade-offs.

S3 and S1 benefit massively from caching without inflating PGA, unlike S5 which holds a huge cache. We evaluate BULK_50/ROW variants on S1/S3 combined with SET_BASED to discover finer low-PGA Pareto points.
